meaning:
δόσις, -εως, ἡ
(δίδωμι) [in LXX for חֹק (Gen.47:22), (Pro.21:14 25:14), frequently in Sir. ;]
1. properly, the act of giving: Php.4:15.
2. Objectively, a gift: Jas.1:17.†
SYN.: see: δόμα (AS)

elsewhere.note: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of…
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
